record.question: My train started at five, _________ in Delhi at seven.
record.explanation: Arriving is a supplementary active participle clause describing the train's subsequent arrival. Arrived lacks a coordinator; having arrived would normally place arrival before starting. Evidence: https://learnenglish.britishcouncil.org/free-resources/grammar/c1/participle-clauses Independently checked solution, unofficial. No matching examiner answer key is asserted.
